defect_reproduced: With the optional DMA setting off, the actual CollectShaderInfoPass removes required dynamic-read resources and actual EmitReadConst loads flatbuffer word zero instead of the requested GPU address/offset. The current game log has that setting off and unflattenable Phi offsets. Causality of RADV loss remains unproven.
restoration: Derive DMA resources from actual unflattened ReadConst instructions rather than the legacy option. Keep already flattened loads unchanged. Require BDA and shaderInt64 for needed loads; refuse unsupported required semantics instead of silently substituting userdata. Restore the earlier 40-bit resolver bound and atomic fault bitmap update. Bump shader binary/meta cache versions from 16/9 to 17/10.
